verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents amount splits that route a defined amount or rate to the platform or a merchant, merchant deposits (payouts) with deposit webhooks, a pre-built reporting component, and full data export. These are pieces of a legible platform ledger, but the docs never describe a per-seller or platform-fee balance view, or a trace linking a charge through its split to a specific payout. missing for 10: balances by seller and by platform fee account, charge→split→payout traceability, penny-level reconciliation reports or settlement files, depth of the reporting component, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform's money is legible — balances by seller and by my own fee accounts, every movement traceable from charge through split to payout, reconcilable to the penny

citations.quote: Each split routes a defined amount or rate-based allocation to the platform or specified merchant.
Configure Rainforest to send webhook notifications for any payment, merchant, or deposit events
pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more
Platforms using Rainforest retain full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time.
